About Me

I believe good carpentry is about doing things properly.

Armed with over 20 years experience working in high-end, bespoke joinery and carpentry, I know what it takes to make your home look the best it can. That's why I approach every project with the same care, precision, and pride. Whether it's a beautifully fitted kitchen, a handmade wardrobe or simply hanging doors, every job gets full commitment and the same attention to detail - regardless of scale.
